# Subway Seat for Starship

Palettes use the slot names of Starship's Gruvbox Rainbow preset, so its segments turn into a red → orange → gold → avocado stripe; they also redefine the standard color names, so other prompts pick up the flavor. `subway-seat.toml` is a complete prompt built on it: point STARSHIP_CONFIG at it or copy it over your config.

[Starship](https://starship.rs) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/starship/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only starship
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`palettes/subway-seat.toml`](palettes/subway-seat.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/starship.toml` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`palettes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](palettes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/starship.toml` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`palettes/subway-seat-enamel.toml`](palettes/subway-seat-enamel.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/starship.toml` |
| All three | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | `~/.config/starship/subway-seat.toml`; use it with STARSHIP_CONFIG=~/.config/starship/subway-seat.toml, or copy it over ~/.config/starship.toml; change `palette` to pick the flavor |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in the top of ~/.config/starship.toml, above every [section] (below a table it would be read as part of that table and ignored), after adding the palette block to the end:

```toml
palette = 'subway_seat'
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in the top of ~/.config/starship.toml, above every [section] (below a table it would be read as part of that table and ignored), after adding the palette block to the end:

```toml
palette = 'subway_seat_tunnel'
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in the top of ~/.config/starship.toml, above every [section] (below a table it would be read as part of that table and ignored), after adding the palette block to the end:

```toml
palette = 'subway_seat_enamel'
```

## Uninstall

- Delete the block between `# >>> subway-seat >>>` and `# <<< subway-seat <<<` in `~/.config/starship.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/starship/subway-seat.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
